purpose: Train/validation subset contract for the 10-gesture demo dictionary that unblocks MODEL-02 / PW-09.

notes: The full Slovo dataset is about 16 GB and is intentionally not committed to this clean repository.
This manifest records reproducible source groups and split rules.
Local Slovo is available in the old mvp1 project and materialization output is stored in data/demo_gestures/materialized_manifest.json.
The materialized manifest records shortages separately from target counts; target counts must not be treated as confirmed physical samples.
Slovo source labels Привет! and no_event are canonicalized explicitly; semantic synonyms are not remapped silently.

source.name: Slovo Russian Sign Language Dataset
source.attribution: Slovo Russian Sign Language Dataset and Models, hukenovs/slovo
source.modification_notes: Dataset content is not modified by this manifest. Future local materialization may copy selected clips under repo-local names only after checksum validation.

split_policy.train: Use Slovo annotations rows with train=True for the target label, sorted by attachment_id, excluding live smoke samples listed in live_smoke_relation.excluded_sample_ids.
split_policy.validation: Use Slovo annotations rows with train=False for the target label, sorted by attachment_id, excluding live smoke samples listed in live_smoke_relation.excluded_sample_ids.
split_policy.label_normalization: Whitespace trim and lowercase are allowed for orthographic variants. Explicit aliases are limited to Привет! -> привет and no_event -> _no_event. Semantic synonyms such as здравствуйте must not be remapped to привет.

non_goal_examples.здравствуйте: candidate synonym only; not remapped to привет
non_goal_examples.работа: different word; not remapped to работать

live_smoke_relation.relationship: Live smoke samples are excluded from train/validation materialization and are reserved as downstream e2e smoke inputs.

known_limitations: Local Slovo was found in the old mvp1 project and materialized through scripts/materialize_demo_gestures_dataset.py without committing videos or archives.
The local Slovo annotations contain source label Привет!, which is explicitly canonicalized to привет; after excluding live smoke sample slovo_privet_f17a6060 the class has 14 train / 5 validation.
After excluding PR #77 live smoke clips, most Slovo-backed gestures have 19 usable samples rather than the target 20.
The local Slovo annotations contain source label no_event, which is explicitly canonicalized to _no_event and materialized as 10 train / 4 validation.
Domain shift may remain between Slovo train/validation clips and live smoke samples from PR #77.
This task does not train a model, export artifacts, or change decoder thresholds.
